races.display_title: Newmarket Academy Godolphin Beacon Project Cornwallis Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict: The Flying Childers could be the key piece of form, with the third-place finisher FLANN SUNNA selected to enhance his positive profile and come out on top. In The Black has come a long way in a short period of time and given she was almost knocked over in that race, her performance can be upgraded. Mussab looks a solid 2-y-o, while Perfect Strike could have a bigger effort in him over 5f. FLANN SUNNA (IRE) IN THE BLACK MUSSAB

races.display_title: Godolphin Lifetime Care Oh So Sharp Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict: NUIT D'ECLAIR has consistently given her running in similar company since her winning debut and this looks a good opportunity for her to deservedly make the breakthrough at this level. Siena Storm wasn't seen to best effect in the Prestige last time and remains with potential, whilst Topaz is also a leading player on the back of her recent win in Italy. races.display_title: bet365 Fillies' Mile (Group 1)
races.verdict: The form of ROGUE PASSION 's Prix d'Aumale success at Longchamp was massively franked on Arc day. She reeled in Sunday's Prix Jean-Luc Lagardère winner Amusingly, with Prix Marcel Boussac runner-up Data almost 4 lengths behind in third. Consequently, Edward Bethell's filly looks the value call over the unbeaten Musical Times , who is already good enough to win most renewals after her romp in the May Hill. ROGUE PASSION (IRE) MUSICAL TIMES (IRE) DANCING DESTINY (IRE)

races.verdict: The vote goes to FORTY YEARS ON , who has proved most progressive in handicaps this season. She looks well worth another chance at listed level, with the forecast rain certainly no harm to her chances. Dance In The Storm again showed plenty of speed when fifth in the Ayr Gold Cup and is still relatively unexposed as a sprinter. races.display_title: HKJC World Pool Handicap
races.verdict: Having finished runner up to a next-time-out winner on her penultimate start, BINTOLA bounced right back to her very best when third in a C&D handicap 3 weeks ago. Leaving the impression she can do better again at this trip, Harry Charlton's filly shades preference over Lion of Mali who has enjoyed a highly productive season and wasn't seen to best effect last time. Nanoscience , George Wickham , Commander of Life and Waistcoat are others to consider in a competitive finale. BINTOLA LION OF MALI NANOSCIENCE
races.betting_forecast: Bintola (9/2), Lion of Mali (5/1), Nanoscience (6/1), Mister Mojito (10/1), Lunario (10/1), George Wickham (10/1), Commander Of Life (10/1), Akabusi (12/1), The Sweet Escape (12/1), Waistcoat (14/1), Righthere Rightnow (14/1), Expert Agent (16/1), Back To Me (20/1), Albemagic (33/1), Majestic Dane (33/1)

races.verdict: NEWS looked potentially useful when bolting up first time out at Southwell last month and with improvement on the cards, George Boughey's filly gets the verdict to defy a penalty. Lily Pink got back on track last time, but she may have to settle for a third silver medal from 4 outings, while Watch Party is also respected with this step up to 1m expected to suit. races.verdict: BOLD SHOUT caught the eye when an unlucky-in-running fourth at Southwell on his first all-weather run and is taken to build on it and make a winning start on polytrack. Course scorer Red Hat Eagle is feared most on the back of a good Thirsk third, while Strong Voice and Majestic Wave need considering too. BOLD SHOUT (IRE) RED HAT EAGLE STRONG VOICE (IRE)

races.display_title: William Hill Gold Weekend Autumn Mile Handicap
races.verdict: A big-field handicap but the claims of BEAGLE BAY are there for all to see having beaten the subsequent John Smith's Cup winner Raammee at Sandown when last seen in June. His subsequent absence is no concern given the yard he represents and looks ahead of his mark. Power Fizz , course specialist Northern Express and Salam Dubawi head the opposition. BEAGLE BAY (FR) POWER FIZZ (IRE) NORTHERN EXPRESS (IRE)

races.display_title: Copper Knight Winning-Most Horse Handicap
races.verdict: Having quickly bounced back to form when landing a small-field conditions event at Beverley 17 days ago, TOCA MADERA remains on the mark he's been competitive from in top-end handicaps this summer and may well be up to defying top weight eased in class. Hallo Spaceboy will find this easier than recent assignments and is feared, as is Baldomero back at 5f from a career-low mark. Copper Knight also deserves an honourable mention with no less than 7 C&D victories to his name. TOCA MADERA (IRE) HALLO SPACEBOY BALDOMERO (IRE)

races.verdict: COOLTOBECARLESS was value for extra when landing a Fakenham bumper in February prior to shaping much better than the distance beaten suggests in a Grade 2 at Aintree on final outing. races.display_title: DragonBet Persian War Novices' Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A good-looking renewal. The vote goes to COSMIC CONNECTION , who took his tally to 3-4 within the space of a couple of months in the spring and Chris Gordon's rapidly-progressive 5-y-o should have no issues with this longer trip. He can take the step up in class in his stride at the expense of Lord Byron , who was narrowly denied at Grade 1 level in Ireland and arrives fit from a spin on the Flat. Stable-switcher North Shore can get the better of La Cote Fleurie for third. COSMIC CONNECTION (IRE) LORD BYRON (IRE) NORTH SHORE (FR)
races.betting_forecast: Lord Byron (2/1), Cosmic Connection (11/4), North Shore (7/2), Lock Stock (10/1), Le Moulin Rouge (14/1), La Cote Fleurie (16/1), West Hill Verde (16/1), Chicker (25/1), Obsessedwithyou (33/1), Handmedownastar (33/1), Hopeful Hero (33/1)

races.verdict: UNA MATATA has been given a chance by the handicapper here and now back at her favoured track she looks the way to go. Boston Max also has winning form here and could prove the chief threat on the back of a solid fourth here after a break, while Mehman and Thaloria also need factoring in. UNA MATATA (IRE) BOSTON MAX (IRE) MEHMAN

races.display_title: Halloween Mid-Term Racing At Dundalk Handicap
races.verdict: CAMINO LAD hasn't looked back since the blinkers went on and can quickly resume winning ways on the back of an excellent recent second here with this step up in trip also a likely plus. Adrian McGuiness' new recruit Serenity Blue could emerge as the main danger, especially if the market vibes are positive, although Showyoutheropes has slipped in the weights and also commands plenty of respect for his in-form stable. CAMINO LAD (IRE) SERENITY BLUE SHOWYOUTHEROPES (IRE)

races.display_title: McGrady Financial Services Beginners Chase
races.verdict: IAMAGETAWAY hasn't been seen since disappointing at Killarney in May, yet he'd previously gone close (shaped best for a long way) when third at Kilbeggan previously and returning for a new yard boasting a healthy recent strike rate with their jumpers, he could well be worth chancing to get back on track. Chase debutant Ring of Kerry and Down Around are others fancied to be thereabouts in what is a tricky affair. IAMAGETAWAY (IRE) RING OF KERRY (IRE) DOWN AROUND (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Down Around (9/4), River Tara (4/1), Astley (5/1), Oh Janey (13/2), Ring Of Kerry (15/2), Rockstown Girl (8/1), Iamagetaway (10/1), Kalsman (12/1), Parkgarve (20/1)

races.verdict: MINI GETAWAY gained a deserved first success at Sligo last week and from her very low base, she may well follow up. King Gris looks an interesting contender up in trip for handicap debut over fences, with Three By Two another to consider on reappearance. MINI GETAWAY (IRE) KING GRIS (FR) THREE BY TWO (IRE)
